verdict.rationale: Martin is itself an AI assistant. Its docs show users telling it to handle email, calendar, Slack, to-dos, notes, reminders and multi-step shortcuts on their behalf, and hands-on community reports confirm it completes complicated requests and manages to-dos across devices. missing for 10: independent evidence quantifying delegation reliability (the vendor admits a nonzero failure rate on actions like sending texts or emails), and detail on how deep multi-step delegation goes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Once connected, you can tell Martin to read, draft, and reply to emails on your behalf.
You can tell Martin to add, edit, and check off your to-dos on your behalf from any interface.
Create custom shortcuts that trigger multi-step actions.
Martin can proactively draft emails for you and send them on your behalf.
it’s handling some complicated requests correctly the first time
I use Martin to manage my todo list while i'm coding (on an hourly basis)
